newsitem.title: USA: CIBER sets acquisition, sees charge.
newsitem.headline: CIBER sets acquisition, sees charge.

text.p: CIBER Inc said Thursday it agreed to acquire Chicago, Ill. based, privately-held Technical Support Group Inc in exchange for about 400,000 CIBER common shares.

Although the second quarter, ending December 31, will reflect a charge related to this transaction, the combination is expected to be accretive to results for fiscal 1997, CIBER said. The company has about 17.8 million shares outstanding.
The acquisition will be a tax-free and accounted for as a "pooling of interests." The closing is scheduled to occur by November 30, and is subject to Technical Support shareholder approval.

Technical Support provides information technology service, specializing in IBM mainframe and client/server development and advanced technical consulting services. It operating at an approximate annual revenue rate of $8.5 million.
